Applied AI at TIYA Services

Three days of hands-on AI training: generative AI with Microsoft 365 Copilot, building agents with the Copilot agent builder, then triggered, scheduled, and multi-agent work in Copilot Studio. Each day stands alone, with its own slides, workbook, agenda, assessment kit, and files. The facilitator guide covers all three.

Notes

Using this kit

  • Fonts. The slides use Roboto Slab and Roboto, Georgia Tech's web typefaces. Install both from Google Fonts on the presenting laptop, or PowerPoint will substitute a similar font.
  • Before delivery. Replace the placeholder data rules with TIYA's written AI policy in each workbook, the guide, and the slides. Fill in "[TIYA contact]" on each deck's closing slide, and the Day 3 date wherever it reads "[Date TBD]".
  • Sharing. Send each cohort only its own day's participant page. The old combined participant link now asks people to choose their day.
  • Printing. Print each day's workbook from its PDF, double-sided. Print assessment kits for instructors only.
  • Offline. The browser decks work from a laptop without internet, with a fallback font. The PowerPoint files are the safest choice for the room.
